capabilities: Upload the current note to uuu.gl from the ribbon, command palette, or hotkey
Upload and embed note images in the published page
Set a custom or random shortcode for the published URL
Sign in with Google to track and manage uploads
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; the README warns that an internet connection is required and that uploaded content is stored on uuu.gl's Firebase servers.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in one-click way to share a single note as a publicly viewable, rendered web page with a short URL.
summary: Uploader that publishes the current note to uuu.gl as a rendered Markdown web page with images preserved and optional password protection.
